Why Aegos

Attention scatters in seconds. Capital leaves tracks that linger.

Timelines churn, every pool looks urgent, every ticker screams. Aegos stares hard at tracks rather than screaming, so the page reflects what truly moved.

Method

Gather widely. Cross-check hard. Rank plainly.

01

Gather

Boosts, pools, swaps and wallet movement get pulled from open Solana sources into one working set.

02

Cross-check

Each claim has to survive a second source. Thin pools, copy-paste tokens and lopsided volume get marked down.

03

Rank

What remains is sorted by a short list of visible rules, so a reader can always trace why a token holds its position.

Pipeline

Four stages between raw ticks and a readable board.

Listings, boosts and pool snapshots land from public endpoints, kept exactly as received.

source → buffer

Tokens are tied to the pools that trade them, and pools to the flows that fill them, so duplicates collapse into one record.

token ↔ pool ↔ flow

Depth, turnover and spend are weighed against each other. A loud token with shallow water scores low.

depth × turnover × spend

Each result reaches the board with raw numbers alongside, ready for whoever wants to challenge it.

score → board

Signals

Four tells worth watching.

Flow

Where size is moving, and whether it keeps moving after the first burst.

Depth

How much a pool can absorb before its price bends.

Cohorts

Whether buyers show up as a crowd or as one actor wearing many hats.

Pace

How quickly interest builds, then how fast it drains.

Using it

Look, question, decide.

  1. 1

    Look

    Open the board and skim the leading rows.

  2. 2

    Question

    Set cost, turnover and depth next to each other before trusting any headline.

  3. 3

    Decide

    Act on personal judgment. Aegos sharpens the view and stops there.
